summary: Count rows, browse Ravelry collections, and read your synced patterns offline.
page_description: A knuckle-sized row counter, Ravelry library browser, and offline pattern reader.
release_notes: Line up a table's columns under the headings that name them, typeset numbered equations, set figures apart from the prose, and carry a document's mathematics all the way through instead of stopping early.

steps.text: Ravelry library sync requires an approved Ravelry API account and HTTP Basic credential.
Install the credential under the exact name ravelry.
Prepare and transfer a PDF you own with Poppler's pdftotext installed.

user: Somebody who knits or crochets with the reader beside the pattern.
job: Count rows, browse your Ravelry collections, and read synced patterns offline.
offline: Synced patterns and your row counts work without the network; browsing Ravelry does not.

data.location: the app's shelf storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; the originals stay in your Ravelry library

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; they are where you stopped

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to browse Ravelry and sync your patterns

capabilities_optional.name: keep-awake
capabilities_optional.gates: keeping the pattern up while you work

non_goals: It does not post to Ravelry.
